provenance.en: Built in Cambodia by POSCAR Digital Co., Ltd.
provenance.km: បង្កើតឡើងនៅកម្ពុជា ដោយក្រុមហ៊ុន POSCAR Digital Co., Ltd.

lead.en: Built by software engineers alongside practising accounting experts.
lead.km: POSCAR Digital បង្កើត វិធាន — ដោយមានគណនេយ្យករជំនាញរួមរៀបចំមុខងារ

body.en:
POSCAR Digital Co., Ltd. is a trusted Cambodian software provider powering school, university, HR, and attendance management systems nationwide. Vithean is POSCAR's flagship accounting and ERP platform, co-developed with Fii & Associates.

Partnering with leading Cambodian accounting and auditing firm Fii & Associates, experienced practitioners help shape every workflow. That is why our general ledger behaves exactly as accountants expect and mirrors how local businesses actually operate.

We are not a foreign product relying on local resellers, nor an agency tinkering with software. We build, support, and implement the system directly alongside your team — ensuring complete data ownership and expert local support.
body.km:
វិធាន ត្រូវបានបង្កើត និងគាំទ្រដោយក្រុមហ៊ុន POSCAR Digital Co., Ltd. ដែលជាក្រុមហ៊ុនកម្មវិធីកម្ពុជា ហើយក៏បង្កើតប្រព័ន្ធគ្រប់គ្រងសាលារៀន សាកលវិទ្យាល័យ ធនធានមនុស្ស និងវត្តមាន ដែលប្រើប្រាស់នៅទូទាំងប្រទេស។ វិធាន ជាផលិតផលគណនេយ្យ និង ERP របស់ខ្លួន។

ក្រុមហ៊ុន Fii & Associates ដែលជាក្រុមហ៊ុនគណនេយ្យ និងសវនកម្មកម្ពុជា គឺជាដៃគូវិជ្ជាជីវៈគណនេយ្យរបស់ វិធាន៖ អ្នកជំនាញរបស់ខ្លួនរួមរៀបចំមុខងាររបស់ប្រព័ន្ធ។ នេះជាមូលហេតុដែលបញ្ជីគណនេយ្យដំណើរការតាមអ្វីដែលគណនេយ្យករគិត ហើយលំហូរការងារត្រូវនឹងរបៀបដែលអាជីវកម្មកម្ពុជាដំណើរការពិតប្រាកដ — ដោយសារអ្នកដែលធ្វើសវនកម្ម និងកាន់បញ្ជីគណនេយ្យជាអាជីព ជាអ្នកកំណត់ថាប្រព័ន្ធត្រូវធ្វើអ្វីខ្លះ។

យើងមិនមែនជាផលិតផលបរទេសដែលមានអ្នកលក់បន្តក្នុងស្រុកទេ ហើយក៏មិនមែនជាសេវាកម្មកាន់បញ្ជីដែលសរសេរកម្មវិធីផងដែរ។ យើងបង្កើត និងគាំទ្រប្រព័ន្ធ យើងដំឡើងវាជាមួយលោកអ្នក ហើយបញ្ជីគណនេយ្យនៅតែជារបស់លោកអ្នក។

story.marksNote: The first two paragraphs carry the maker mark and the practice-partner mark respectively. Order matters: keep the POSCAR paragraph first and the Fii paragraph second. Each mark floats beside its opening lines, so logoHeight is per-mark: the two source files are cropped differently (Fii's square canvas has padding baked in) and they need different heights to read at the same weight.

mission.en: To create a user-friendly, customised and flexible platform with the analytic data needed for easy, time-saving and effective decision-making, while meeting local requirements.
mission.km: បង្កើតទម្រង់មុខងារមួយដែលមានភាពងាយស្រួល ស្របតាមតម្រូវការ និងបត់បែន ដោយផ្តល់ជូននូវបទពិសោធន៍ថ្មីមួយសម្រាប់ម្ចាស់អាជីវកម្ម និងការរីកចម្រើននៃសហគ្រាសធុនតូច និងមធ្យម តាមរយៈការគ្រប់គ្រង និងការរៀបចំផែនការហិរញ្ញវត្ថុ ដែលមានការវិភាគទិន្នន័យច្បាស់លាស់ ចំណេញពេលវេលា ដើម្បីងាយស្រួលក្នុងការសម្រេចចិត្តប្រកបដោយប្រសិទ្ធភាព និងធានាបាននូវការអនុលោមតាមបទប្បញ្ញត្តិនានាក្នុងស្រុក។

vision.en: To be the leading accounting system in Cambodia's digital market, providing single-package solutions that are innovative, customised and affordable.
vision.km: ក្លាយជាប្រព័ន្ធគណនេយ្យឈានមុខគេក្នុងទីផ្សារឌីជីថលនៅកម្ពុជា ដែលផ្ដល់នូវដំណោះស្រាយល្អបំផុតសម្រាប់សហគ្រាសធុនតូច និងមធ្យម ជាមួយផលិតផល និងសេវាកម្មប្រកបដោយភាពច្នៃប្រឌិត ស្របតាមតម្រូវការ និងតម្លៃសមរម្យ។

values.en: A flexible digital accounting system designed around what our customers actually need, combining practical experience and technical knowledge, for the growth of Cambodia's SME sector.
values.km: យើងផ្ដល់នូវប្រព័ន្ធគណនេយ្យបែបឌីជីថលដែលមានភាពបត់បែន និងងាយស្រួល ដែលបង្កើតឡើងជាពិសេសដើម្បីបំពេញតម្រូវការរបស់អតិថិជន ដោយរួមបញ្ចូលនូវបទពិសោធន៍ប្រតិបត្តិផ្ទាល់ និងចំណេះដឹងបច្ចេកវិទ្យាពីគ្រប់វិស័យទាំងអស់ ដើម្បីភាពរីកចម្រើននៃវិស័យសហគ្រាសធុនតូច និងមធ្យមនៅកម្ពុជា។

team.bio: Managing Partner of 3E:Fii Capital, responsible for valuation, financial advisory and research. Founded Jayu Management & Research in Phnom Penh in 2017. Graduate of EDHEC Business School, Lille, with an MBA from the University of Chicago Booth School of Business.

team.name: Ms. HENG Seida
team.credential: Past President of KICPAA · FCCA (UK) · CIA (US)
team.bio: Over 20 years in internal and external audit and in building internal control systems. Served as Vice President then President of KICPAA across two mandates; during her terms the national CPA and CAT qualifications were developed. Co-founder and Managing Partner of Fii & Associates.

platform.portalNote: my.vithean.com is not public yet. While portalLive is false the 'My account' link is hidden from the footer. Flip it to true when the portal goes live — the URL is already correct.

payments.note: Displayed under 'We accept'. Card-scheme and bank marks are shown per the acquiring bank's requirements — use the artwork supplied by the bank, do not redraw it.

linkedinNote: Primary LinkedIn is the POSCAR Digital company page (/company/poscar) — a real entity anchor for sameAs. The Vithean showcase page (/showcase/vithean) hangs off it and is secondary; showcase pages are weak entity anchors.

khmer.glossary: src/i18n/glossary.json — accounting terms extracted from the product's own km locale files. Those words are used verbatim here; do not substitute synonyms.
khmer.englishByDefault: Demo figures, document references and account names stay in English on both locales — most Cambodian accountants work in English for the ledger itself, and translating INV-2026-0412 or 'Accounts receivable' would make the example harder to verify.
khmer.verified: Strings marked VERIFIED were taken from the live vithean.com/km pages (archived in vithean-public/docs/existing/km/).
khmer.drafted: Everything else is drafted. Rule 1 of the bilingual policy is 'write Khmer, do not translate English' — headlines and value propositions must be authored by a Khmer-native writer working from the message house, not reviewed as translations.

languages.articles: Any language. Each article declares its own `lang`; both locales list all of them.
languages.note: The SYSTEM interface ships Khmer, English and Chinese — verified: zh locale files in vithean-ui, vithean-myweb and vithean-central-web. Worth stating as a product fact. The WEBSITE and SUPPORT are English and Khmer only: no /cn/ route, no Chinese switcher. Say 'the system interface' whenever Chinese is mentioned — dropping those two words is what turned the old site's 'KH, EN, CN' into a credibility bug when /cn/ returned 404.

maker.note: The maker of Vithean, not a partner. Vithean is one of POSCAR Digital's product brands; POSCAR is the contracting party on the CamInv integration, the Canadia Bank partnership and the IFA memorandum.

line.en: Vithean is a product co-developed by POSCAR Digital Co., Ltd. and Fii & Associates.
